ideas: SSHStalker botnet compromises Linux systems via IRC and SSH
Old techniques like IRC control can still be effective
Legacy systems and weak SSH configurations pose significant risks
Basic security hygiene is crucial for preventing such attacks
Retiring or isolating legacy kernels and hardening SSH configurations can mitigate risks
Monitoring for suspicious behaviors like per-minute cron execution is important
items.rating_reason: The article provides high-value insights into the SSHStalker botnet, its methods of operation, and expert advice on mitigation. It efficiently delivers multiple novel ideas, including the use of old techniques like IRC control and the importance of basic security hygiene. The content is thematically relevant to cybersecurity, specifically highlighting the risks associated with legacy systems and weak SSH configurations.

items.title: AI agents can spill secrets via malicious link previews • The Register
items.summary: AI agents can leak sensitive data through automatic link previews, enabling zero‑click exfiltration.
ideas: Zero-click prompt injection can exfiltrate data via AI agents' link previews without user interaction.
Messaging apps automatically fetch metadata from URLs, turning AI‑generated links into data‑leaking channels.
Platforms like Microsoft Teams, Discord, Slack are vulnerable when AI agents generate preview URLs.
Adjusting OpenClaw’s config can mitigate the link‑preview exploitation.
Developers should expose and customize link‑preview settings to create LLM‑safe communication channels.
PromptArmor provides a testing site to check AI agents for insecure link preview behavior.
Attackers can embed sensitive info (e.g., API keys) into URLs that preview fetches expose.
items.rating_reason: The article delivers several concrete value instances: it explains zero‑click prompt injection via link previews, lists vulnerable platforms, offers mitigation steps, and points to a testing resource. The content aligns well with cybersecurity and AI themes and avoids clickbait or padding, resulting in good density for its medium length.
